# Brain map evaluation

<!-- Generated by scripts/brain/eval.mjs (`npm run brain:eval`). Static part re-runs on demand; the live A/B section is recorded by hand from real agent runs. -->

Tokens ≈ characters / 4 (an estimate; the same rule for both sets). **Pointer recall** = of the flow's source files that real commits changed (git history), the share the reading set names by path or file name. Baseline = what the skills instruct an agent to read before building today (noon-ui step 2, the resources "read first" list, the screen skill, the brief, the flow's code entry points and components). Brain = noon-ui SKILL.md + INDEX + `brain context` + the items it lists.

| **all** | 306 | 183 · 431,627 | 96% | 70 · 100,887 | 95% | |

Context size: the brain set is 23% of the baseline (330,740 fewer tokens over 5 tasks).

## Ground-truth files the brain set does not name

The brain set names screen modules and the components of the closest screens; it deliberately does not list every helper. These are the files an agent would still have to find with `brain deps` or a search:

- home: `src/flows/home/components/BrandAdModule.module.css`, `src/flows/home/components/CategoryGrid.module.css`, `src/flows/home/components/DepartmentTabs.module.css`, `src/flows/home/components/HeroBanners.module.css`, `src/flows/home/components/KeepShopping.module.css`, `src/flows/home/components/LaunchModule.module.css`, `src/flows/home/components/OfferTickets.module.css`, `src/flows/home/components/ProductRail.module.css`, `src/flows/home/components/PromoTicker.module.css`, `src/flows/home/components/RecommendedRail.module.css`
- search-results: `src/flows/plp/components/brandWidget.module.css`
- pdp: `src/flows/pdp/components/RecoCard.tsx`, `src/flows/pdp/components/Stars.tsx`
- cart: none
- checkout: `src/flows/checkout/components/DeliveryPrimitives.tsx`, `src/flows/checkout/components/ProviderForm.tsx`

## Not measured here

- Visual similarity to references, motion and navigation correctness of a *generated* screen, implementation errors and revision cycles: they need an agent to build the screen and a reviewer (or `visual:ref`) to score it. The live A/B below measures retrieval only.
- Ground truth comes from large multi-flow commits, so it is "files that changed in this flow", not "files one task needed": recall is an upper-bound style signal, not task accuracy.

## Live A/B (recorded 2026-10-13)

Six read-only Explore agents, one per task and arm, same prompt except the retrieval rule (baseline: existing guidance only, brain map forbidden; brain: start with `brain context`). Each planned which files to edit, what to reuse and which checks to run. Usage from the harness; ground truth checked by hand against the source. n = 1 per cell, so treat differences of a few percent as noise.

| Task | Arm | Tokens | Tool calls | Time | Core files found | Notable |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| cart progress bar | baseline | 39,337 | 5 | 34.5 s | yes (data.ts, DemoStore.tsx, GroupProgressBar, group.module.css, tokens.ts) | — |
| cart progress bar | brain | 37,629 | 7 | 33.4 s | yes (same + html.module.css) | flagged that `CartGroup` recomputes `remaining` from the cart tokens instead of `cartTotals.groups` |
| pdp variant tiles | baseline | 34,712 | 6 | 29.9 s | yes (SfVariantsCard.tsx + .module.css) | found one of two height gaps (out-of-stock branch) |
| pdp variant tiles | brain | 33,816 | 4 | 30.4 s | yes (same) | found both gaps (also details skipped when there's no sale price); ran `impact` → 3 screens to snap, named 4 journeys |
| checkout pay method | baseline | 36,893 | 8 | 38.9 s | yes (data.ts, data.payment.ts, data.postorder.ts, PaymentSummary) | — |
| checkout pay method | brain | 41,815 | 7 | 37.4 s | yes (same) | named 3 journeys (`checkout-slide-to-pay`, `cart-checkout`, `checkout-payment-failure`); flagged the summary row as a gap with no existing pattern |
| **total** | baseline | 110,942 | 19 | 103.3 s | 3/3 | |
| **total** | brain | 113,260 | 18 | 101.1 s | 3/3 | |

**What this shows.** For focused, single-flow change tasks, agents already search efficiently with grep, so the map did **not** reduce tokens, tool calls or time (both arms are within about 2%). Both arms found every core file. The map's measurable gains were in the plan's completeness: the exact journeys and screens to re-run (`impact`), one extra correctness issue found per task in two of three tasks, and explicit gaps. The 77% context reduction in the static table above is against *reading what the skills instruct*, which agents in practice partly skip; it is not a saving these runs observed.

**Not yet measured:** build-and-review runs (visual similarity, motion and navigation correctness of generated screens, error and revision counts), larger cross-flow requests, and runs with a weaker model, where retrieval help is more likely to matter. Re-run this table when the map changes materially.
